searchText: The spec is now updated: https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/pull/157#issuecomment-701550852 I really want to focus on interop now <@!194432762315407360> I'm working on getting my implementation up-to-date with latest spec right now. If you have test vectors or a running bootnode I can probably be at the point of testing agaiinst it by the end of today or sometime tomorrow. OK I will publish new test vectors after putting my kids to bed Actually, I just realized we could maybe put back the WHOAREYOU size reduction trick from v5.0 by moving `src-id` into `authdata` for message/handshake packets and omitting it in WHOAREYOU. That would reduce it by another 32 bytes. It was pretty nasty to implement it this way in go-ethereum, but would be very easy for me to add it back in. The `src-id` is technically not required because `nonce` uniquely identifies the packet that prompted the WHOAREYOU response. Since it's like that in 5.0, all implementations should already know how to match the handshake attempt using just `nonce`. I'm just going to go for it, it will provide us with a lot of headroom for future updates to have it this much smaller. Pushed it. Also pushed the test vectors, they're here: https://github.com/fjl/devp2p/blob/discv5-v1-update/discv5/discv5-wire-test-vectors.md#packet-encodings
